# CP-3 Case Packer Functional Description: Review and Rewrite

The integrator's text cannot be tested at FAT in its current form. It also has three problems that need action before anything else:

- **Safety:** E-stop and guard-door behavior depend on the standard PLC, and doors resume automatically.
- **Wrong PackML states:** The Held and Suspended assignments are swapped.
- **Missing behavior:** Jam, starvation recovery, restart, and fault handling are undefined.

I kept PackML (ISA-TR88.00.02) as the state model. It fits a discrete packaging machine better than ISA-106, which covers continuous processes.

## 1. Review findings

| ID | Location | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | E-stop | Wired to PLC input I:3/0 and stopped by the PLC. A standard PLC input is not a safety function. | Hardwire the E-stop to a safety relay or safety PLC per the SRS. Keep I:3/0 as a status input only (FR-CP3-001, 002). |
| F-02 | E-stop | "Stops all motors" does not define the zone, the stop category, or the reset. Nothing prevents an automatic restart. | Define the zone in the SRS. Require a manual reset, then Clear and Reset (FR-CP3-003). |
| F-03 | Guard doors | The machine resumes automatically when doors close. This is an unexpected-restart hazard. | Hold the machine after doors close. Require a deliberate START (FR-CP3-005). |
| F-04 | Guard doors | "Pauses" has no PackML state. Door-lock behavior, run-down time, and door-open during Starting or Stopping are undefined. | Door open gives a safe stop per the SRS and the BPCS goes to Held (FR-CP3-004). Lock and bypass go to open items. |
| F-05 | States | Downstream full gives Held. In PackML, Held is for internal or operator-initiated conditions. | Downstream full gives Suspended, with automatic recovery (FR-CP3-006). |
| F-06 | States | Operator Stop gives Suspended. Stop must give Stopping, then Stopped. | Correct the transition (FR-CP3-008). |
| F-07 | States | There is no state table and no modes. Permissives, exits, and automation level are not stated. | Add the state table in section 3. |
| F-08 | Starvation | "The machine stops" names no state or restart. The 5 s value is in prose. | Starvation gives Suspended with automatic recovery. The time moves to SP-CP3-01 (FR-CP3-007). |
| F-09 | Jam | There is no blocked time, so every passing case reads as a jam. The location of PE-320, the response, and the reset are missing. | Add the time as SP-CP3-05. A jam gives Held, latched (FR-CP3-009). |
| F-10 | Speed | It is unclear whether 30 cases/min is nominal or maximum. The text gives no range, no tolerance, and no ramp. | Put the value in the setpoint list. Open item OI-04. |
| F-11 | Tags | Motors, pushbuttons, the downstream-full sensor, and the stack light have no tags. | Provisional tags in section 2. Confirm against the instrument index. |
| F-12 | Whole document | There are no sequences, timeouts, or failure responses. | Sequence tables in section 5. |
| F-13 | Whole document | Bad PV, comms loss, power loss and restart, and fail positions are missing. | Section 8. |
| F-14 | Whole document | The text has no alarms, no operator interface, and no requirement IDs. | Sections 7, 9, and 4. |
| F-15 | E-stop | The text puts a PLC address in a functional description, and the red stack light has no defined meaning. | Remove the address from the requirements. Add the stack light table in section 9. |

## 2. Purpose, boundaries, tags

CP-3 packs bottles into cases. Infeed conveyor M-310 brings bottles in. Outfeed conveyor M-330 moves full cases to the downstream conveyor. The upstream and downstream lines are outside this module. The CP-3 safety zone is an open item (OI-01).

All tags below except PE-310, PE-320, GS-1 to GS-6, and I:3/0 are provisional. Confirm each against the instrument index.

| Tag | Use |
|---|---|
| PE-310 | Infeed bottle presence |
| PE-320 | Jam detection (location: confirm) |
| PE-330 | Outfeed full detection (provisional) |
| M-310 / M-320 / M-330 | Infeed conveyor / packer main drive / outfeed conveyor (provisional) |
| GS-1 to GS-6 | Guard door switches (safety, per SRS) |
| XS-300 | E-stop chain status, I:3/0 (status only) |
| HS-301 / 302 / 303 / 304 | START / STOP / RESET / HOLD pushbuttons (provisional) |
| HL-300 | Stack light (provisional) |

## 3. States and transitions

| State | Entry permissive | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aborted | Power-up, or Aborting done | Clearing | Operator (RESET) | Operator-prompted |
| Clearing | Safety reset made | Stopped, Aborted | Auto | Automatic |
| Stopped | Clearing done, or Stopping done | Resetting, Aborting | Operator | Operator-prompted |
| Resetting | All E-stops and doors OK, no drive fault | Idle, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Idle | Resetting done | Starting, Stopping, Aborting | Operator (START) | Operator-prompted |
| Starting | START pushed, permissives OK | Execute, Stopping, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Execute | Starting done, or any Un-state done | Suspending, Holding, Stopping, Aborting | Auto, operator | Automatic |
| Holding | HOLD pushed, jam, or guard door open | Held, Stopping, Aborting | Auto, operator | Automatic |
| Held | Holding done | Unholding, Stopping, Aborting | Operator (START) | Operator-prompted |
| Unholding | Cause cleared, doors closed, START pushed | Execute, Holding, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Suspending | Infeed starved or outfeed full | Suspended, Holding, Stopping, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Suspended | Suspending done | Unsuspending, Stopping, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Unsuspending | Cause cleared for its clear time | Execute, Suspending, Aborting | Auto | Automatic |
| Stopping | STOP pushed, or sequence failure | Stopped, Aborting | Operator, auto | Automatic |
| Aborting | E-stop, drive fault, or timeout | Aborted | Auto | Automatic |

Completing and Complete are not used until OI-05 is closed. Production, Maintenance, and Manual modes are open item OI-06.

## 4. Requirements

| ID | Requirement | FAT test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CP3-001 | The safety circuit removes power from hazardous motion when any E-stop is pressed. The SRS defines this function. The BPCS does not perform it. | Press each E-stop. Verify the stop per SRS. |
| FR-CP3-002 | When XS-300 shows E-stop active, the BPCS goes to Aborting, then Aborted. It sets AL-CP3-01. | Press E-stop. Verify the state and alarm. |
| FR-CP3-003 | After an E-stop, the machine stays in Aborted until the E-stop and safety reset are done, then RESET is pushed. | Release E-stop. Verify there is no motion. Verify the reset sequence. |
| FR-CP3-004 | When any of GS-1 to GS-6 opens in Execute, the safety circuit stops motion per SRS. The BPCS goes to Holding, then Held. | Open each door in Execute. Verify the stop and Held. |
| FR-CP3-005 | After all doors close, the machine stays in Held until START is pushed. | Close doors. Verify no motion. Push START. Verify Unholding. |
| FR-CP3-006 | When PE-330 stays blocked for SP-CP3-03, the machine goes to Suspending. It returns to Execute after PE-330 stays clear for SP-CP3-04. | Block PE-330. Verify Suspended, then clear and verify recovery. |
| FR-CP3-007 | When PE-310 shows no bottle for SP-CP3-01, the machine goes to Suspending. It returns to Execute after bottles show for SP-CP3-02. | Remove bottles. Verify Suspended and recovery. |
| FR-CP3-008 | When STOP is pushed, the machine goes to Stopping, then Stopped. | Push STOP in Execute. Verify the sequence. |
| FR-CP3-009 | When PE-320 stays blocked for SP-CP3-05, the machine goes to Holding, then Held. It sets AL-CP3-03. The state is latched. | Block PE-320. Verify Held. Verify no auto-reset. |
| FR-CP3-010 | The machine goes from Suspended to Stopping after SP-CP3-06. | Hold the cause. Verify Stopping at timeout. |
| FR-CP3-011 | In Execute, the machine runs at the rate in SP-CP3-07. | Run for a timed period. Compare the case count to the rate. |

## 5. Sequences

**SQ-CP3-01 Starting**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check permissives | Doors closed, no E-stop, no drive fault, comms OK | SP-CP3-09 | Stopping, AL-CP3-08 |
| 2 | Start M-330 | M-330 run feedback | SP-CP3-09 | Stopping, AL-CP3-08 |
| 3 | Start M-320 | M-320 run feedback | SP-CP3-09 | Stopping, AL-CP3-08 |
| 4 | Start M-310 | M-310 run feedback | SP-CP3-09 | Stopping, AL-CP3-08 |

**SQ-CP3-02 Stopping**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stop M-310 | M-310 stopped | SP-CP3-10 | Aborting, AL-CP3-09 |
| 2 | Let the packer finish its cycle, then stop M-320 | M-320 stopped | SP-CP3-10 | Aborting, AL-CP3-09 |
| 3 | Stop M-330 | M-330 stopped | SP-CP3-10 | Aborting, AL-CP3-09 |

**SQ-CP3-03 Suspending and Holding**

The steps are the same as SQ-CP3-02, with these differences:
- In Suspending caused by starvation, M-330 keeps running so that packed cases clear.
- In Suspending caused by outfeed full, M-330 stops.
- In Holding, all three motors stop.
- Step timeouts use SP-CP3-13 for Suspending and SP-CP3-14 for Holding.
- A timeout gives Aborting and AL-CP3-09.

**SQ-CP3-04 Unsuspending and Unholding**

The steps are the same as SQ-CP3-01, in the order M-330, M-320, M-310. The timeout is SP-CP3-13. A failure gives Holding and AL-CP3-08.

**Resetting and Clearing:** Verify that the safety reset is made, clear the latches, and verify that the drives are ready. The timeout is SP-CP3-11 for Resetting and SP-CP3-12 for Clearing. A failure leaves the machine in its current state and sets AL-CP3-09.

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was given, so the rows are written here. Safety rows are defined in the SRS. The BPCS only monitors them.

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IL-01 | E-stop pressed (XS-300) | Safety stop. BPCS Aborting. | Latched | Release, safety reset, RESET |
| IL-02 | Any of GS-1 to GS-6 open | Safety stop. BPCS Holding. | Latched in Held | Close doors, safety reset if SRS requires, START |
| IL-03 | PE-330 blocked for SP-CP3-03 | Suspending | Auto-reset | PE-330 clear for SP-CP3-04 |
| IL-04 | PE-310 clear for SP-CP3-01 | Suspending | Auto-reset | Bottles present for SP-CP3-02 |
| IL-05 | PE-320 blocked for SP-CP3-05 | Holding | Latched | Clear jam, START |
| IL-06 | Drive fault on M-310, M-320, or M-330 | Aborting | Latched | Fix fault, RESET |
| IL-07 | Comms loss, drives (SP-CP3-16) | Aborting | Latched | Restore comms, RESET |
| IL-08 | Comms loss, downstream handshake | Treat as outfeed full | Auto-reset | Comms restored |

## 7. Alarms

No alarm database was given. Priorities are provisional. Rationalize them to ISA-18.2.

| ID | Alarm | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| AL-CP3-01 | E-stop active | High | Find the cause. Release the E-stop. Reset. |
| AL-CP3-02 | Guard door open | Medium | Close the door. Push START. |
| AL-CP3-03 | Jam at PE-320 | Medium | Clear the jam. Push START. |
| AL-CP3-04 | Infeed starved | Low | Check the upstream line. |
| AL-CP3-05 | PE-310 or PE-320 fault | Medium | Check the sensor and wiring. |
| AL-CP3-08 | Drive fault or start failure | High | Check the drive. Reset. |
| AL-CP3-09 | State sequence timeout | High | Check the motors. Reset. |
| AL-CP3-10 | Comms loss | High | Check the network. Reset. |

Outfeed full is a status message, not an alarm.

## 8. Abnormal handling

- **Bad PV:** A broken wire or stuck output on PE-320 reads as blocked and gives a jam Hold with AL-CP3-05. A stuck-clear PE-310 reads as starvation and gives Suspended. A stuck-blocked PE-330 reads as outfeed full.
- **Comms loss:** See IL-07 and IL-08.
- **Power loss:** All motors stop. All outputs go to the de-energized state.
- **Power restore:** The controller starts in Aborted. It never starts a motor without a RESET and a START.
- **Fail positions:** Pneumatic actuators fail to their safe position (OI-07).

## 9. Operator interface

The operator sees:
- the PackML state,
- the active alarms,
- the rate,
- the case count,
- the status of each door and each photoeye.

The operator can push START, STOP, HOLD, and RESET, and can change the rate within its limits. Prompts are: "Close all doors, then push START" for Held, and "Clear the jam at PE-320, then push START" for jam.

| State | Stack light HL-300 |
|---|---|
| Execute | Green, steady |
| Held, Suspended | Amber, flashing |
| Aborting, Aborted | Red, steady |
| Stopped, Idle | Off |
